name: Paris-Le Bourget Airport

curfew.v: jet take-offs, use of reverse thrust and use of runway 2 by aircraft over 5.7 tonnes are banned between 22:15 and 06:00
curfew.applies_to: jet take-offs, reverse thrust, runway 2 for aircraft over 5.7 t

missing: operator (Groupe ADP; not named on the readable page)
notes: French eAIP, Légifrance (arrêté of 15 Feb 2011 on Le Bourget restrictions) and most Paris Aéroport pages (bot protection) could not be opened. The 22:15-06:00 ban is on jet take-offs (not landings), reverse thrust and runway 2 for aircraft over 5.7 t; it is not a full closure. The ADP page's own time base is assumed local; it does not say UTC. COHOR also links an arrêté of 23 June 2023 making Le Bourget coordinated for the 2023 Rugby World Cup; status beyond that event is unclear. COHOR page last modified 9 Jul 2025.
